reason: Trophophylls are the leaves, and 'adnate to branches' is attachment to branches (towards PO_0025073). Adnate (FLOPO_0991129) under structure fits.

target: rosette leaf (PO_0000014), or leaf with position basal (FLOPO_0991002)
fix: In a leaf paragraph, a bare position word starting a clause ('basal ...; principal cauline ...') names a leaf type. It must set the bearer (rosette or basal leaf) or the position slot, not be dropped.

fix: In botany, 'compressed' means flattened, not condensed. PATO 'condensed' (defined as thicker or more closely packed) lists 'compressed' as a synonym, and that synonym should not be used to ground flora shape text.

The inflorescence is few-flowered: flowers present in small number, with the inflorescence as the container. This matches the text.

fix: In FDAC Sapindaceae (Chytranthus), the organ described as obovate, 15–45 cm long and acuminate is the leaflet ('foliole') of a pinnate leaf. The heading word should set the bearer.

fix: The 'approximately' qualifier has no source in 'anthers rose'. There is no ±, -ish, c. or 'nearly' here; it was probably borrowed from 'nearly entire' earlier in the context. A qualifier should only come from a word inside the statement's span.

target: position abaxial (abaxial face of the phyllary)

target: place: tip (apex) of the involucral bract

fix: Hyphenated 'crenate-dentate' could be kept as a relation between crenate and dentate rather than dentate alone.

target: base of the leaflet (place slot 'base' on leaflet PO_0020049)
